ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels (~95%) with a sparse distribution of high-intensity white pixels (~5%) primarily as speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black contiguous base with stochastic high-intensity micro-blobs (specks) distributed across both lobes. A concentration of high-intensity pixel clusters is visible on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 85 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the base of the visible fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (serrations) punctuated by several deeper jagged indentations, particularly on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory originating from the median notch, curving upward and outward to form sharp, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; additional scattered circular white specks are present across the central lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple white unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches/rake marks) are visible, particularly on the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma marks visible as white linear rake marks on the right lobe and barnacle encrustation/scarring on both lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-frequency speckling pattern across the dark pigmentation surface.
